node.title: KoalaBear m2 r2 dihedral degree-two source-star exclusion
node.closure: regular D2 coset incidence, normalized source cross-edge lemma, and exact four-vertex defect floor
node.statement: In the full-V4 (m,r,delta)=(2,2,4) row, the degree-two Dickson/Chebyshev factor profile is impossible. At one generic pole of the outer map, regular D2=V4 incidence makes both Z values see the same two Y values. Their endpoint and complete-source lifts force eight star units onto four cross vertices, whose minimum defect is four, above the proved budget three. Together with the degree-five exclusion, the surviving factor degrees are n=3,6. No m=2 type, owner charge, or prize row is closed.
